decisions.reason: As a close-to-core launch with its own product page, it still has unresolved market potential and likely low enough incremental carrying costs to justify keeping the option open.

Because this generic antidepressant is more distant from the firm’s established offer and likely faces tougher price competition, it is the weakest option in the portfolio, but after only one year the uncertainty is still high enough to continue for now.
This antihypertensive combination fits the firm’s established pharmaceutical capabilities and channels, so management would likely retain it while early demand and positioning become clearer.

Although it had less prominent website support, the supplement builds on the firm’s self-care direction and should be relatively inexpensive to keep on the market while its commercial value is tested.
